analyst.summary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India makes braking and safety-control systems for trucks and buses under the global ZF Group. The business grew revenue and profit at healthy rates in FY26, remains essentially debt-free, and recently won new Electronic Stability Control business from three OEMs tied to tightening Indian safety regulations. The stock's valuation is rich relative to the auto-components sector, which is the main caution. We rate it a Hold.
